name: datacite-mcp-server
description: Discover datasets, software, and other research outputs; resolve DataCite DOIs; trace scholarly relationships; and generate citations.

interface.shortDescription: Discover datasets and software, resolve DataCite DOIs, trace relationships, and generate citations.
interface.longDescription: Search DataCite's registry of datasets, software, models, workflows, reports, and other research outputs by topic, creator, funder, institution, repository, place, or year. Resolve a DataCite DOI to its full deposited metadata and landing page, trace versions, parts, supplements, and citations with each relationship's direction preserved, find the repositories that publish in a field, and format citations as CSL-styled text, BibTeX, RIS, and other machine formats. Read-only; no API key required.
